title: SB1253 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Title 55, Chapter 50, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2025-02-06; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513074214 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/SB1253.pdf (LegiScan doc 3104683))
provenance.note: Draft (as filed) dated 2025-02-06; summary says "As introduced", no passage vote listed, so no adopted amendments are missing. House twin HB1098 shares this document. Adds a new subsection; deletes nothing.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(k)(1)): A person commits an offense who knowingly carries or possesses a firearm, including a firearm that was privately assembled and does not contain a serial number or other mark in a manner that conforms with the requirements imposed on licensed importers and licensed manufacturers of firearms pursuant to 18 U.S.C. § 923(i), and, at the time of possessing or carrying, is not a citizen of the United States or a lawful permanent resident, as defined by § 55-50-102.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(k)(2)): An offense under subdivision (k)(1) is a Class A misdemeanor.
